title: `EditorExportPlugin._export_end()` called multiple times when exporting with a `EditorExportPlatformWeb`
body:
### Tested versions

- Godot 4.3 (steam release)

### System information

Godot v4.3.stable (77dcf97d8) - Windows 10.0.22635 - GLES3 (Compatibility) - Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (Intel Corporation; 30.0.101.1404) - 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1165G7 @ 2.80GHz (8 Threads)

### Issue description

In a class inheriting `EditorExportPlugin`, `_export_end()` is called multiple times if exporting to the web platform, as opposed to a PC (windows or linux) platform (also tested by me, to see if this bug was actually the intent of the function and if it was a documentation issue)

I observed this when using my addon (https://github.com/NovaDC/Godot-CommandExportPlugin, which depends on https://github.com/NovaDC/Godot-Novatools v1.1 or up) during a web export. I believe this is a godot issue as I see no other way this could be misused.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a `EditorExportPlugin` with a `_export_end` method override and `_supports_platform` override that returns `true` for a `EditorExportPlatfromWeb`; and some means to add that `EditorExportPlugin` so it shows up in the export menu.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I've provided example code below, please use that instead. You may also observe this bug when using the plugin that I have already mentioned if you prefer.
